Class Teacher

java.lang.Object
Actors.User
Actors.Employee
Actors.Teacher
All Implemented Interfaces:
IResearcher, Serializable
public class Teacher extends Employee
Represents a teaching staff member of the university.

Teachers hold one of four academic titles defined by TeacherTitle: TUTOR, LECTOR, SENIOR_LECTOR, or PROFESSOR. Professors are automatically activated as researchers upon creation; other titles can opt in by updating their ResearchProfile.

Core responsibilities:

  • Managing assigned courses and recording student marks (ATT1 0–30, ATT2 0–30, Final 0–40).
  • Viewing per-course statistics (average total, pass rate).
  • Research activities: publishing papers (with co-author linking), creating and joining ResearchProjects, updating h-index and school.

Teacher rating is accumulated from student votes (1–5 scale) and exposed as a running average via getRating().
